samples.question: Start at the green arrow, facing its point. Repeat 20 moves. On a blank square, use its own shade: LIGHT turns right and DARK turns left, then flip that square. On a lettered square, instead use the OTHER same-letter square's shade to turn, then flip that other square. Move ahead. The path stays on-board. After move 20, which goal holds the cursor? Answer goal-A, goal-B, goal-C, or goal-D.
